Responsibilities below are qualified from the 505f1b71a^ content. Session and commands are extracted and tested. Lost: (1) the cross-map selection reset. A fresh SpatialTerrainSurfaceEditingSession treats source == null as sameMap in load(), so it would keep a view.spatialSurfaceId from another map and could select a same-id surface there. Only the widget guarded this. (2) Resync on external change or canvas selection: unlike the ramp session, the surface session has no synchronize(), and only the widget triggered the reload. Writes stay safe because preview/apply/delete check identity (tested), so these are binding/UX gaps, not data-loss gaps.
